what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to accept its fiscal year 2022 goals.
The board held a preliminary talk on a means-tested senior property tax exemption and will ask the finance director for numbers, then schedule a workshop.
A fall special town meeting was proposed for November 16, with the warrant opening at the end of August and closing September 28; no one objected.
The board reappointed election officers and ratified the town manager's appointments of board and committee clerks.
The town manager said the state budget leaves the town with a deficit that new growth might offset, and that a plan for American Rescue Plan funds would come around late September or early October.

why_it_matters: A means-tested senior tax exemption would shift part of the property tax burden, and residents may be asked to vote on it at a town meeting once the finance director's numbers are in.
The special town meeting warrant and the plan for American Rescue Plan spending are where residents will be asked to decide on money, and the state aid shortfall frames those choices.
